mainEntity.name: How much does a typical home remodeling project cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Home remodeling costs vary widely based on scope, materials, and location. Small updates like painting or fixtures might cost under $10,000; kitchen or bathroom remodels typically range $10,000–$50,000+, while full renovations are higher.
